name: hashscraper
description: Coupang top 30 and public web data bots (Naver, Instagram, Olive Young, maps, reviews) for AI agents
long_description: Collect public web data from your AI agent with HashScraper's 120+ ready-made data bots — Coupang best-seller top 30 by category, Naver blog/cafe/news/shopping/maps, Instagram, YouTube, Olive Young, Musinsa, Kurly, KREAM, Google/Kakao maps, app stores and more. Connect your account with the login tool (free sign-up included) or set an API key from My page -> API.

hashscraper_api_key.title: HashScraper API key (optional)
hashscraper_api_key.description: Optional. A HashScraper API key from My page -> API at https://www.hashscraper.com. Leave empty and use the login tool to connect in the browser.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Connect your HashScraper account in the browser (device login, free sign-up included).

tools.name: me
tools.description: Show the connected account and how many daily free credits are left today.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Search the built-in list of 120+ ready-made data bots and their inputs. Works offline.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Collect public web data with one HashScraper bot and return the rows.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get the rows of an earlier run by dataset id.

tools.name: coupang_categories
tools.description: List the Coupang categories whose daily best-selling top 30 is ready.

tools.name: coupang_top
tools.description: Get today's best-selling top 30 products of a Coupang category with price, reviews and delivery.
